preconditions.description: Attacker must be the owner of the MarvinInu contract to call owner-protected functions.
A victim account must possess MarvinInu tokens to be able to sell them and incur the high fee.

exploit_hint: The attacker, as the contract owner, first calls `updateSellFees` to set an exorbitant fee rate (e.g., 50%). Then, a victim account (which can be another account controlled by the attacker) holding the MarvinInu token sells it on a DEX. Due to the high fee, a large portion of the tokens are sent to the contract itself. Finally, any subsequent swap or transfer can trigger the `swapBack` function, which converts the collected fee tokens into ETH and sends them to the owner's marketing and dev wallets, thus realizing the profit.
